title: Make a rapid fire video that shows a different neighborhood of Charleston SC…
content: Make a rapid fire video that shows a different neighborhood of Charleston SC every 1s, upbeat music, include text to label it.

es.content:
Haz un video de disparo rápido que muestre un barrio diferente de Charleston SC cada 1s, música animada, incluye texto para etiquetarlo.

y Omni captó absolutamente las referencias https://t.co/VZoVYq24MM
